SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, MIN(pv.unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(pv.stock_quantity) AS max_stock, MIN(pv.product_code) AS product_code, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(pr.rating) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ), 0) AS average_rating, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ) AS review_count FROM products p JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_reviews pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE WHERE
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY
MIN(pv.unit_price) ASC, p.product_id ASC
MIN(pv.unit_price) DESC, p.product_id ASC
MAX(p.sale_start_at) DESC, p.product_id ASC
p.product_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.rank, p.product_id, p.product_name, MIN(pv.unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(pv.stock_quantity) AS max_stock, MIN(pv.product_code) AS product_code, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(pr.rating) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ), 0) AS average_rating, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ) AS review_count FROM popular_product_rankings r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN product_reviews pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE WHERE r.ranking_date = (SELECT MAX(ranking_date) FROM popular_product_rankings) GROUP BY r.rank, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.category_id, p.assembly_available, p.assembly_fee, p.has_variation, p.variation_group_id, p.variation_name, AVG(pr.rating) AS average_rating, COUNT(pr.review_id) AS review_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_reviews pr ON pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.sale_start_at <= #{now} AND (p.sale_end_at IS NULL OR p.sale_end_at > #{now}) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.category_id, p.assembly_available, p.assembly_fee, p.has_variation, p.variation_group_id, p.variation_name

SELECT pr.review_id, pr.member_id, pr.product_id, pr.rating, pr.title, pr.body, pr.is_published AS published, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = #{productId} AND pr.is_published = TRUE ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.review_id DESC

SELECT pv.product_variant_id, pv.product_code, pv.color_id, c.color_name, c.color_code, pv.unit_price, pv.stock_quantity FROM product_variants pv JOIN colors c ON c.color_id = pv.color_id WHERE pv.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, pv.product_variant_id ASC

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name FROM products p WHERE p.variation_group_id = #{variationGroupId} AND p.sale_start_at <= #{now} AND (p.sale_end_at IS NULL OR p.sale_end_at > #{now}) ORDER BY p.product_id ASC

SELECT r.rank, p.product_id, p.product_name, MIN(pv.unit_price) AS min_price, MAX(pv.stock_quantity) AS max_stock, MIN(pv.product_code) AS product_code, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(pr.rating) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ), 0) AS average_rating, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews pr WHERE pr.product_id = p.product_id AND pr.is_published = TRUE ) AS review_count FROM recommended_related_products r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.recommended_product_id JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.source_product_id = #{sourceProductId} AND r.recommendation_date = (SELECT MAX(recommendation_date) FROM recommended_related_products) GROUP BY r.rank, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT color_id, color_name, color_code, swatch_type FROM colors WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, color_id ASC
SELECT top_shape_id AS option_id, display_name FROM desk_top_shapes WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, top_shape_id ASC
SELECT taste_id AS option_id, display_name FROM desk_tastes WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, taste_id ASC
SELECT function_id AS option_id, display_name FROM chair_functions WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, function_id ASC
SELECT material_id AS option_id, display_name FROM chair_materials WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, material_id ASC
SELECT taste_id AS option_id, display_name FROM chair_tastes WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, taste_id ASC
SELECT usage_id AS option_id, display_name FROM storage_usages WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, usage_id ASC
SELECT taste_id AS option_id, display_name FROM storage_tastes WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY sort_order ASC, taste_id ASC
SELECT tax_rate_percent FROM tax_rates WHERE is_active = TRUE AND effective_start_at <= #{now} AND (effective_end_at IS NULL OR effective_end_at > #{now}) ORDER BY effective_start_at DESC LIMIT 1
